info.title: Lightning SPP API
info.description: Lightning SPP HTTP API: runtime health, workspace licensing, customer accounts, Stripe fulfillment and real image/PDF processing. SDK processing, Linux CUPS/SANE devices and private Longo storage are separate interfaces. Account POST requests require same-origin JSON and a CSRF token; email delivery depends on the configured provider.

customerSession.description: Production session cookie obtained by verified-email login. Local non-production cookie name: LightningCustomer. Browser sends it automatically.

post.summary: Recover an existing paid invoice event
post.description: Reads the existing invoice.paid event from Stripe and idempotently fulfills it. No additional charge is taken; notification failure retains the key for retry.

Stripe server-to-server endpoint. Preserve the raw JSON payload for signature verification. Paid invoice fulfillment retains durable entitlement and receipt state; unsupported events may be acknowledged without issuance.

schema.description: Stripe event object; use the original bytes.

post.summary: Process a real image or PDF
post.description: Public demo. Send raw binary bytes (not multipart), a positive Content-Length and at most 8 MiB. PDFs: at most 32 pages. Images are limited to 8 million decoded pixels. Returns actual measured timings, PNG preview and PDF or compressed image artifact. One demo job runs at a time; rate limits apply.

400.description: Invalid size, media type, profile or document

422.description: Document could not be validated, rendered or processed

503.description: Another demo job is running; retry shortly

post.summary: Process a document and download ZIP with a verification report
post.description: Same validation, 8 MiB input limit, 32-page PDF limit, profiles, concurrency and shared demo rate budget as /api/try/process. Returns processed.pdf or processed.png, preview.png and report.json. No ZIP input, supplier classification or splitting. Report license status describes the server runtime, not the visitor entitlement.

200.description: Complete processed document and verification report ZIP

400.description: Invalid size, media type, profile or document

503.description: Another demo job is running; retry shortly
